name: Scrivener
description: Scrivener is a long-form writing application for planning, drafting, organizing, researching, revising, and compiling manuscripts, scripts, dissertations, books, and other complex documents.
agentUseSummary: Scrivener cannot yet be connected to Relay agents because its supported interoperability consists of local multi-file project packages, external-folder text synchronization, and user-managed cloud folders rather than a public API, while Relay Marketplace does not currently ship a separately authorized local-file authority.

blocked.label: Connect Scrivener
blocked.description: Relay does not present a software license, Dropbox account, cloud-storage account, or local project folder as a Scrivener API connection.

blocked.label: Access Scrivener projects
blocked.description: Scrivener projects are multi-file local packages and external-folder sync is a user-configured desktop workflow; Relay cannot currently mount either as a separate selected local-file authority.

blocked.label: Automate private Scrivener behavior
blocked.description: Relay does not automate the app UI, parse or modify internal project XML and packages, reuse device state, request cloud credentials, or call undocumented services.

blocked.label: Change or compile projects
blocked.description: Creating, reading, editing, moving, deleting, synchronizing, backing up, compiling, or exporting project documents, research, metadata, outlines, and manuscripts remains unavailable until Relay ships explicit local-file execution and approval boundaries.

approvalProfiles.label: Unavailable
approvalProfiles.description: No agent actions can be enabled until Relay ships a separately disclosed, user-authorized local Scrivener project connector using only supported file workflows.

runtimeSupport.description: Relay does not silently give OpenClaw access to local Scrivener packages, external sync folders, or cloud-storage folders.
Relay does not silently give Hermes access to local Scrivener packages, external sync folders, or cloud-storage folders.

providerSetup.blocker: Scrivener exposes local multi-file project packages and a desktop external-folder text-sync workflow, not a documented public third-party API; provider support also confirms Scrivener has no AppleScript implementation. Relay's current Marketplace runtime excludes local-app command execution and lacks a separately selected local-file authority safe for these complex project packages.
providerSetup.nextAction: Do not request Dropbox or other storage credentials, inspect or modify .scriv packages, automate Scrivener, or show Connect. Reconsider after Relay ships a separately disclosed Mac/Windows local-file connection architecture with project and external-folder selection, coordinated app-closed checks, pinned supported operations, per-action approval, path/content redaction, backups, audit, and no cloud fallback.

evidence.supports: Literature & Latte documents Scrivener projects as multi-file local packages, requires projects to be closed before cross-device cloud access, and recommends local backups to avoid corruption and data loss.
Literature & Latte documents desktop external-folder sync as a local text-editor interoperability workflow and distinguishes it from Scrivener project synchronization.

Literature & Latte documents user-linked Dropbox folder synchronization through installed desktop and iOS apps, whole local .scriv projects, manual close/sync sequencing, and partial-download failure risks.
Literature & Latte's support forum confirms Scrivener has no AppleScript support and warns that direct project-package parsing is not officially supported and may damage projects.
